heading.en: Background and army career

body.zh-Hant: 寺內壽一（1879–1946）是山口縣出身，與父親寺內正毅一樣成為元帥與陸軍大臣。他於明治32年（1899年）11月自陸軍士官學校（第11期）畢業，明治42年12月畢業於陸軍大學校，1919年7月任大佐、近衛步兵第3聯隊長，1924年2月任少將、步兵第19旅團長，1927年8月任朝鮮軍參謀長，1929年8月任中將、獨立守備隊司令官，歷任第5師團長、第4師團長，1934年8月任台灣軍司令官。
body.en: Terauchi Hisaichi (1879–1946) was from Yamaguchi and, like his father Terauchi Masatake, became a field marshal and army minister. He graduated from the Army Officers School (11th class) in November 1899 and the Army War College in December 1909; he became a colonel and commander of the 3rd Imperial Guard Infantry Regiment in July 1919, a major general and commander of the 19th Infantry Brigade in February 1924, chief of staff of the Korea Army in August 1927, and a lieutenant general and commander of the Independent Garrison Unit in August 1929. He then led the 5th and 4th Divisions and became commander of the Taiwan Army in August 1934.

heading.en: Army Minister and the purge of the army

body.zh-Hant: 二二六事件之後，寺內於昭和11年（1936年）3月出任陸軍大臣，首相官邸資料顯示該內閣（廣田內閣）於3月9日成立，在職至昭和12年（1937年）2月2日。他的主要工作是為肅軍而刷新人事與修改陸軍省官制，其中復活軍部大臣現役武官制影響最大。
body.en: After the February 26 Incident Terauchi became Army Minister in March 1936; the Prime Minister's Office records that the Hirota cabinet was formed on 9 March and remained in office until 2 February 1937. His main work was personnel reshuffling to purge the army and revising the Army Ministry's organization regulations, the revival of the rule that service ministers be active-duty officers being the most significant.

body.zh-Hant: 1937年2月，寺內任軍事參議官兼教育總監；同年8月任北支那方面軍司令官，1938年12月再任軍事參議官；1939年7月至11月前往德國、義大利出差。

heading.en: Commander-in-Chief of the Southern Army

body.zh-Hant: 昭和16年（1941年）11月寺內就任南方軍總司令官，昭和18年（1943年）6月晉升元帥。太平洋戰爭期間，他以南方軍總司令官身分在廣大戰區指揮超過一百萬名官兵；身為司令官，他除了大綱的決心與屬下各軍意見的裁決外，似乎多交由總參謀長以下處理。
body.en: In November 1941 Terauchi became commander-in-chief of the Southern Army and in June 1943 was promoted to field marshal. During the Pacific War he commanded more than a million officers and men over a vast theatre as commander-in-chief of the Southern Army; besides deciding broad outlines and ruling on opinions from subordinate armies, he is said to have left most matters to the chief of staff and below.

heading.zh-Hant: 南方軍總司令部的遷移與降伏
heading.en: Southern Army headquarters moves and the surrender

body.zh-Hant: 南方軍總司令部於1944年4月5日遷往馬尼拉，同年5月11日再遷往西貢（胡志明市）。1945年9月12日在新加坡簽署的降伏文書載明，南方軍最高司令官寺內元帥向東南亞盟軍最高司令官無條件投降。戰後南方軍總司令部移至新加坡，1946年3月15日再遷往柔佛巴魯辦理復員業務。
body.en: The Southern Army headquarters moved to Manila on 5 April 1944 and to Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City) on 11 May 1944. The instrument of surrender signed at Singapore on 12 September 1945 records Field Marshal Count Terauchi, Supreme Commander of the Japanese Expeditionary Forces, Southern Regions, surrendering unconditionally to the Supreme Allied Commander, South East Asia. After the war the headquarters moved to Singapore, and on 15 March 1946 it relocated to Johor Bahru to carry out demobilisation.

heading.zh-Hant: 英帕爾戰役準備與戰敗
heading.en: Preparing the Imphal operation and defeat

body.zh-Hant: 昭和18年（1943年）2月瓜達康納爾島撤退後，太平洋方面戰局惡化，但南方軍正面的緬甸第一次阿恰布作戰有望進展。8月7日，寺內命令緬甸方面軍準備反擊作戰（英帕爾戰役）。昭和19年7月英帕爾作戰失敗，昭和20年4月仰光陷落，他於昭和21年（1946年）6月在馬來西亞的連甘病逝。
body.en: After the withdrawal from Guadalcanal in February 1943 the war situation on the Pacific front worsened, but the first Akyab operation in Burma on the Southern Army front looked promising. On 7 August Terauchi ordered the Burma Area Army to prepare a counter-offensive, the Imphal campaign. The Imphal operation failed in July 1944, Rangoon fell in April 1945, and he died of illness at Rengam in Malaysia in June 1946.

heading.en: Background and the German mission

body.zh-Hant: 山下奉文（1885–1946）是高知縣出身的陸軍大將。他於明治38年（1905年）11月自陸軍士官學校（第18期）畢業，歷任軍事調查部長等職；昭和16年（1941年）1月起以視察團長身分訪問納粹德國四個月，返國後擔任關東防衛軍司令官等職。
body.en: Yamashita Tomoyuki (1885–1946) was an army general from Kōchi. He graduated from the Army Officers School (18th class) in November 1905, served in posts including chief of the Military Investigation Department, and from January 1941 spent four months in Nazi Germany as head of an inspection mission; after returning he served as commander of the Kantō Defense Army among other posts.

heading.zh-Hant: 馬來作戰與新加坡攻略
heading.en: The Malaya campaign and Singapore

body.zh-Hant: 山下在太平洋戰爭初期以第25軍司令官身分指揮馬來作戰。馬來攻略作戰計畫在1941年11月他就任第25軍司令官後確定。昭和16年12月8日，第25軍強襲登陸馬來半島，以70天（預定為100天）攻下英國引以為傲的東洋堡壘新加坡。他因此被稱為「馬來之虎」，與海軍的山本五十六並列為緒戰的戰勝將軍。
body.en: In the early Pacific War Yamashita commanded the Malaya campaign as commander of the 25th Army; the plan was fixed after he took up that command in November 1941. On 8 December 1941 the 25th Army landed by assault on the Malay Peninsula and took Singapore, Britain's Eastern bastion, in 70 days instead of the planned 100. He became known as the "Tiger of Malaya" and, with the navy's Yamamoto Isoroku, is rated as a victorious general of the opening phase.

heading.zh-Hant: 第14方面軍與雷伊泰、呂宋決戰
heading.en: Fourteenth Area Army and the Leyte and Luzon battles

body.zh-Hant: 昭和19年（1944年）9月22日，陸軍大將山下奉文就任第14方面軍司令官，指揮呂宋決戰與雷伊泰地面決戰。10月20日他抵達呂宋島，約兩週後美軍約10萬人登陸雷伊泰島；方面軍增援第35軍的部隊大多在海上輸送時被擊沉，12月15日美軍又登陸民都洛島，25日雷伊泰作戰中止。
body.en: On 22 September 1944 General Yamashita took command of the Fourteenth Area Army and directed the decisive battles of Luzon and Leyte. He arrived on Luzon on 20 October; about two weeks later roughly 100,000 US troops landed on Leyte. Most reinforcements sent to the 35th Army were sunk in transit, US forces landed on Mindoro on 15 December, and the Leyte operation was cancelled on 25 December.

heading.en: Surrender in 1945

body.zh-Hant: 戰爭結束後，昭和20年（1945年）9月2日，山下司令官前往坎幹的美軍聯絡所報到；翌3日在呂宋島碧瑤於麥克阿瑟代理人薩瑟蘭中將面前簽署降伏文書，並與參謀長武藤章中將同日被押往馬尼拉收監。
body.en: After the war ended, Commander Yamashita reported to the US liaison post at Kiangan on 2 September 1945; on the 3rd he signed the instrument of surrender at Baguio on Luzon in the presence of Lieutenant General Sutherland, MacArthur's chief of staff, and was escorted to Manila and imprisoned that day together with his chief of staff, Lieutenant General Mutō Akira.

heading.en: Birth and early career

body.zh-Hant: 山本五十六生於明治17年（1884年）4月4日，新潟縣出身，是海軍軍人。他於明治37年（1904年）自海軍兵學校畢業，海軍大學校畢業後歷任駐美大使館付武官、航空母艦赤城艦長等職，昭和4年（1929年）以隨員身分參加第一次倫敦裁軍會議。
body.en: Yamamoto Isoroku was born on 4 April 1884 in Niigata and became a naval officer. He graduated from the Naval Academy in 1904, and after the Naval War College served as naval attaché at the embassy in the United States and captain of the carrier Akagi, among other posts; in 1929 he took part in the first London Naval Conference as a member of the delegation.

heading.en: Naval aviation and vice-minister

body.zh-Hant: 他以第一航空戰隊司令官、海軍航空本部長的身分致力強化海軍航空部門。昭和11年（1936年）起任海軍次官，輔佐海相米內光政，並反對日德義三國同盟。
body.en: As commander of the 1st Carrier Division and head of the Naval Aviation Headquarters he worked to strengthen naval aviation. From 1936 he was vice-minister of the navy, supporting Navy Minister Yonai Mitsumasa and opposing the Tripartite Pact with Germany and Italy.

heading.zh-Hant: 出任聯合艦隊司令長官
heading.en: Commander-in-Chief of the Combined Fleet

body.zh-Hant: 昭和14年（1939年）8月30日，山本五十六就任聯合艦隊司令長官（任期至昭和18年4月18日）。昭和16年11月5日，他裁決對美英荷作戰的「機密聯合艦隊命令作第一號」；12月2日收到「大海令第十二號」後，從旗艦長門向全部隊發出「登上新高山一二〇八」的暗號電報，下達12月8日開始作戰。
body.en: On 30 August 1939 Yamamoto Isoroku became commander-in-chief of the Combined Fleet, a post he held until 18 April 1943. On 5 November 1941 he approved Combined Fleet Secret Operation Order No. 1 for the war against the United States, Britain and the Netherlands; after receiving Imperial Naval Order No. 12 on 2 December he sent the code signal "Climb Mount Niitaka 1208" from the flagship Nagato to all forces, ordering operations to begin on 8 December.

heading.en: The attack on Pearl Harbor

body.zh-Hant: 昭和16年（1941年）12月8日，聯合艦隊司令長官山本五十六在開戰之初以奇襲攻擊真珠灣的美國太平洋艦隊，企圖使美國國民喪失戰爭意志。機動部隊以雷擊隊、戰鬥機隊、俯衝轟炸隊與水平轟炸隊攻擊戰艦群和機場；日本時間3時37分，山本接獲機動部隊「奇襲成功」的消息。
body.en: On 8 December 1941 Combined Fleet commander Yamamoto Isoroku attacked the US Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbor in a surprise strike at the outset of the war, aiming to destroy the American public's will to fight. The carrier force attacked the battleships and airfields with torpedo, fighter, dive-bomber and level-bomber units; at 3:37 Japan time Yamamoto learned from the force that the surprise had succeeded.

heading.zh-Hant: 杜立德空襲與中途島作戰
heading.en: The Doolittle Raid and the Midway operation

body.zh-Hant: 昭和17年（1942年）4月18日，美國陸軍中校杜立德指揮的轟炸機16架空襲東京等本州各地，這是日本本土首次遭空襲。日美開戰前就擔心美軍機空襲本土的山本，以及軍令部與陸軍，在此後正式推進中途島作戰的準備。中途島攻略作戰失敗，日本損失主力航空母艦4艘，海軍卻隱瞞了這件事。
body.en: On 18 April 1942 sixteen bombers under US Army Lieutenant Colonel James Doolittle raided Tokyo and other parts of Honshu, the first air raid on the Japanese home islands. Yamamoto, who had feared such raids since before the war, together with the Naval General Staff and the army, then pressed ahead with preparations for the Midway operation. The Midway invasion operation failed with the loss of four main carriers, and the navy concealed the fact.

heading.en: Front-line inspection and death

body.zh-Hant: 昭和18年（1943年）4月18日，山本長官在「伊」號作戰結束後，搭乘一式陸攻前往視察前線部隊途中遭美國戰鬥機襲擊，在布干維爾島戰死。長官一行早上6時5分自拉包爾機場起飛，約7時40分在布因上空附近與美軍戰鬥機十餘架遭遇；其國葬於同年6月5日舉行。
body.en: On 18 April 1943, after the conclusion of Operation I-Go, Admiral Yamamoto was attacked by US fighters on his way by Type 1 bomber to inspect front-line units and was killed on Bougainville. His party took off from Rabaul airfield at 6:05 a.m. and met a dozen or more enemy fighters near Buin at about 7:40; his state funeral was held on 5 June of that year.

body.zh-Hant: 杉山元1880年1月2日生於福岡，陸軍士官學校第12期畢業，1904年2月出征日俄戰爭，1910年11月自陸軍大學校畢業，其後歷任參謀本部員、駐印度武官、航空課長、軍事課長、陸軍省軍務局長，1930年8月出任陸軍次官。
body.en: Sugiyama Hajime was born in Fukuoka on 2 January 1880, graduated from the Army Officers School (12th class), went to the Russo-Japanese War in February 1904 and graduated from the Army War College in November 1910. He then served as a General Staff officer, attaché in India, chief of the Aviation Section and the Military Affairs Section, and director of the Army Ministry's Military Affairs Bureau, becoming vice-minister of the army in August 1930.

body.zh-Hant: 1937年2月至1938年6月，他在林內閣與第一次近衛內閣擔任陸軍大臣；首相官邸資料顯示，1938年6月3日板垣征四郎接任陸軍大臣。1938年6月任軍事參議官，同年11月任北支那方面軍司令官。
body.en: From February 1937 to June 1938 he was Army Minister in the Hayashi and first Konoe cabinets; the Prime Minister's Office records that Itagaki Seishirō took over as Army Minister on 3 June 1938. He became a Supreme War Councillor in June 1938 and commander of the North China Area Army in November 1938.

heading.zh-Hant: 參謀總長與對美英荷開戰命令
heading.en: Chief of the Army General Staff and the order for war

body.zh-Hant: 1940年10月3日，杉山元就任參謀總長（任期至1944年2月21日）。昭和16年（1941年）12月2日，杉山參謀總長向南方軍總司令官發電，通知「大陸命第五六九號」已發令，其內容為「帝國決定對美國、英國及荷蘭開戰」，並命令南方軍總司令官於12月X日開始進攻（進入）作戰；他以暗號「日出」為「山形」下達12月8日開始作戰。
body.en: Sugiyama became Chief of the Army General Staff on 3 October 1940 and held the post until 21 February 1944. On 2 December 1941 he telegraphed the commander-in-chief of the Southern Army that Imperial Headquarters Army Order No. 569 had been issued, whose content was the decision to open war on the United States, Britain and the Netherlands, and ordered operations to begin on 8 December using the code "Hinode is Yamagata".

heading.en: Field marshal and second term as Army Minister

body.zh-Hant: 1943年6月晉升元帥。1944年7月任教育總監，並在小磯內閣再任陸軍大臣；依JACAR資料，其陸軍大臣任期為1944年7月22日至1945年7月20日。1945年4月任第1總軍司令官。
body.en: He was promoted to field marshal in June 1943. In July 1944 he became Inspector General of Military Training and again Army Minister in the Koiso cabinet; according to JACAR his term as Army Minister ran from 22 July 1944 to 20 July 1945. In April 1945 he became commander of the First General Army.

heading.en: The end of the war and suicide

body.zh-Hant: 1945年8月15日，負責防衛東日本的第1總軍司令官杉山大將向轄下方面軍發電，要求各級指揮官在終戰時堅守團結、依統帥命令行動。9月10日第1總軍下令於9月12日零時解除戰鬥序列，杉山於9月12日在第1總軍司令部自決。
body.en: On 15 August 1945 General Sugiyama, commander of the First General Army responsible for the defence of eastern Japan, telegraphed his subordinate area armies, asking commanders at all levels to maintain solidarity and act strictly on orders from the supreme command at the end of the war. On 10 September the First General Army ordered its order of battle dissolved at midnight on 12 September, and Sugiyama killed himself at its headquarters on 12 September.

heading.en: Commissioning and the siege of Port Arthur

body.zh-Hant: 永野修身（1880–1947）於明治35年（1902年）1月任海軍少尉。日俄戰爭中他是海軍陸戰重砲隊第3中隊長（當時為中尉），參加圍攻旅順；明治37年12月8日的記錄載，中隊長在203高地上，砲擊命中敵艦「阿穆爾」14發。該中隊自明治37年8月至翌年1月共發砲6,530發，對乃木第3軍攻略旅順有所貢獻。
body.en: Nagano Osami (1880–1947) was commissioned a navy sub-lieutenant in January 1902. In the Russo-Japanese War, as a lieutenant commanding the 3rd Company of the naval land heavy-artillery unit, he took part in the siege of Port Arthur; the entry for 8 December 1904 records that from 203 Meter Hill his fire hit the enemy ship Amur 14 times. From August 1904 to January 1905 the company fired 6,530 rounds and contributed to General Nogi's Third Army taking Port Arthur.

heading.en: Superintendent of the Naval Academy

body.zh-Hant: 永野修身自昭和3年（1928年）12月至昭和5年（1930年）6月擔任海軍兵學校長。他當時為海軍中將，向教職員示達學習方針，以重視意志陶冶、重視個性等為學習方針，並努力改革學習方法。
body.en: Nagano served as superintendent of the Naval Academy from December 1928 to June 1930. As a vice-admiral he issued a study policy to the staff that stressed training of the will and attention to individuality, and he worked to reform learning methods.

heading.en: Navy Minister in the Hirota cabinet

body.zh-Hant: 昭和11年（1936年）3月9日廣田內閣成立，永野修身列名海軍大臣；廣田內閣在職至昭和12年（1937年）2月2日。永野後來也歷任聯合艦隊司令長官、軍令部總長等要職。
body.en: The Hirota cabinet was formed on 9 March 1936 with Nagano Osami listed as Navy Minister; the cabinet remained in office until 2 February 1937. Nagano later also held senior posts including commander-in-chief of the Combined Fleet and Chief of the Naval General Staff.
